answer: Pseudonym parties stop Sybils the way a falcon spots one bird in a flock: agents must attend a synchronous, location-bound ceremony where each participant proves presence by answering a fresh prompt. A river of fake identities cannot flow from one person, because one body can sit in only one ceremony at a time, and receipts go on a public board. Anyone whispering the same answers from two seats forfeits both deposits, since voiceprints and timing expose the clone. Attackers must hire a real human per fake identity, raising a Sybil army's cost from near zero to a full wage per puppet.
